scope: AEMO NEMWeb; five NEM regions; four 28-day out-of-time seasonal folds per region; 560 region-days; 50 AUD/MWh-discharged decision gate

adaptive_conformal_inference.boundary: ACI-inspired online controller, not a reproduction of the paper or a guarantee; coverage stabilisation can require operationally unacceptable width.

decision_focused_evaluation.boundary: SPO-inspired evaluation only; neither forecast was trained with SPO+ loss.

calibrated_cvar_policy.result: failed improvement gate; all three region-fold CVaR selections that passed calibration were worse on unseen realised tail margin, while SA1 and VIC1 were unchanged because every fold fell back to point dispatch
calibrated_cvar_policy.boundary: Scenario CVaR is retained as a tested feasibility path and negative ablation, not a claimed risk or revenue improvement.

resources.requested_per_task: 2 CPU, 2 GiB, 5 minutes; at most two concurrent tasks

rejected_runs.reason: legacy shared-checkout provenance race and missing SA1 manifest; no merged result published
merge imported the ML evaluation module in a dependency-light runtime; afterok compute shards remained valid and only the merge was repaired

economic_boundary: Historical spot-market operating-margin proxy only. Cycling cost is user supplied, not an asset-specific degradation model. Excludes CAPEX, fixed O&M, network fees, FCAS, bidding/settlement complexity and investment returns.
